requirements.evidence: All contract items present: entities migration with `$table->string('slug')->unique('entities_slug_unique')`, timestamps, softDeletes (database/migrations/2026_10_29_073911_create_entities_table.php:18-21); memberships migration with cascade FKs, `$table->string('role')->default('employee')`, `unique(['entity_id','user_id'], 'entity_memberships_entity_user_unique')` (database/migrations/2026_10_29_073912_create_entity_memberships_table.php:17-21); owner_seq stored generated column + `unique(['entity_id','owner_seq'], 'entity_memberships_one_owner')` (:22-25); Entity getRouteKeyName/owner/memberships/users (app/Models/Entity.php:20,28,36,48); UserRole enum with `manageable()` returning `[Admin, Employee]` (app/Models/UserRole.php:6-19); User memberships/entities/membershipFor (app/Models/User.php:38,46,53); factories with owner/admin/employee states (database/factories/EntityMembershipFactory.php:24-47); both policies with the exact abilities and no constructor (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:9-37, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:9-35). Policy edge cases match the task: owner deletion always denied, self-removal allowed, manageSettings owner-only.

conventions.evidence: Good: migrations have reversible `down()` and look generated (database/migrations/2026_10_29_073912_create_entity_memberships_table.php:29-33); `$fillable` set deliberately (app/Models/Entity.php:18, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:21); authorization in policies, no routes/UI; docs and CHANGELOG synced (docs/database-schema.md:152-153, CHANGELOG.md:21). Deviations: no tests at all, against 'No production code without a test' (no files under tests/ in change.diff); `User::membershipFor()` is the only new public method without a PHPDoc block (app/Models/User.php:52-55) despite the docs convention.

security.evidence: Every ability is server-side in a policy: create true for authenticated policy call (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:11-13), view/update/delete/manageSettings derive membership from the DB (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:16-36), membership view/assignRole/delete likewise (app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:11-31); owner membership undeletable (:26). No unescaped output, no user input, no secrets, and `$fillable` excludes the generated `owner_seq` (app/Models/EntityMembership.php:21).

tests.evidence: change.diff adds no test files at all — no coverage for Entity/EntityMembership/UserRole, the factories, the policies' authorization paths, or the database-level single-owner constraint. Read the whole diff (536 lines, nothing summarized).

simplicity.evidence: Lean, no speculative layers: EntityPolicy::delete delegates to update (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:29-32), EntityMembershipPolicy::delete reuses assignRole (app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:24-31), single-owner enforced in the schema instead of application code (database/migrations/2026_10_29_073912_create_entity_memberships_table.php:22-25), one-statement scopes (app/Models/EntityMembership.php:50-70).

readability.evidence: Clear names and small focused methods throughout (app/Models/Entity.php:48-51, app/Models/UserRole.php:17-20); typed relations with generics PHPDoc (app/Models/Entity.php:26-28, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:20-22); policy methods read as the rules in task.md; no dead code or debugging.

scope.evidence: Everything in the diff serves the task: two migrations, models, enum, two factories, two policies, plus the required docs/database-schema.md update and the matching run of CHANGELOG entries (CHANGELOG.md:9,16). No routes, UI, middleware or session work.

issues.explanation: The change ships zero Pest/PHPUnit tests, so nothing verifies the policies' allow/deny rules, the factories' states, or the `owner_seq` unique-index behaviour that the task calls its key invariant, and it breaks the project's mandatory test-first rule.
`membershipFor()` lacks the PHPDoc block its sibling new methods all have, while conventions require PHPDoc on public methods touched in a change.

Dropping `locale_default` from the diagram goes beyond the doc fix the task asked for (replacing `owner_membership_id`), since locale support is explicitly out of scope; it is only defensible if the project really dropped that planned column.

The `@method static Builder|static owner()/admin()/employee()` block duplicates information the concrete `scopeOwner`/`scopeAdmin`/`scopeEmployee` methods already give and adds noise without improving IDE support for this project's tooling.

review.summary: The change implements the whole entity/membership data model, enum, factories and both policies, and the schema-level single-owner constraint is expressed portably with a stored `owner_seq` column plus a unique index; authorization rules match the task and the docs/CHANGELOG are updated. The one thing keeping it from approval is the complete absence of tests, which the project's conventions make mandatory for every behaviour, including these policies and the database constraint.
